readScope: Drug Facts indications, warnings, directions, storage and inactive ingredients for all four formulations; package text where displayed, not package images. Also read complete Lastacaft OTC Drug Facts and Alembic azelastine prescribing text, including special populations; no package images. Read cromolyn February 2025 prescribing and patient text, and Alocril June 2018 prescribing/patient text and September 2022 marketing-end record. Read displayed Zerviate indication, dosage, container, lens, adverse-event, special-population, formulation and storage passages (not all study/nonclinical lines); read Somerset epinastine prescribing text through patient counseling. Read all three pages of extracted FDA 2003 Alomide label text; this is historical evidence only. Manufacturer PDF search excerpt was available but direct retrieval returned 404; DailyMed setid retrieval failed. Read downloaded FDA 2026 Orange Book title and Alomide entry on PDF page 886, under Discontinued Drug Product List; not the entire Orange Book.
findings: Expanded vague exact-label advice into concentration-specific olopatadine dosing and ketotifen age/interval/salt-equivalence counseling.
Added explicit 72-hour stop rules and differentiated reinsertion timing from suitability for lens wear.
Pataday 0.2% SPL includes incongruous 0.7% carton text; relied on Drug Facts and active ingredient record for the 0.2% formulation, cross-checked separately against 0.7% Drug Facts.
Added previously absent alcaftadine, including current OTC status; expanded azelastine formulation, route, dose, age, storage and adverse-effect counseling.
Added cromolyn vernal indications, regular dosing and delayed response; no-contact-lens instruction applies throughout treatment.
Added historical nedocromil coverage while explicitly qualifying availability by the reviewed presentation marketing-end record.
Added cetirizine ophthalmic single-use handling, including preserved formulation versus mandatory disposal; added assessment case.
Added epinastine dosing throughout exposure, age, lens and manufacturer-specific storage.
Added lodoxamide conceptual/vernal-disease coverage with explicit historical-label boundary. Did not transfer historical dosing, storage or pregnancy category into current recommendations.

Resolved availability gap: 2026 FDA Orange Book lists Alomide, lodoxamide tromethamine equivalent 0.1% base, NDA 020191 product 001, as discontinued. Updated lesson explicitly; no assertion that discontinuation was for safety or efficacy.
